people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Babylon has suddenly fallen and been destroyed! Wail for her! Take balm for her pain. Perhaps she may be healed.
translations.bsb: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and been shattered. Wail for her; get her balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.
translations.kjv: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
translations.asv: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: wail for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
